name: reviewable_priorities
setup: INSERT INTO reviewables (id, type, type_source, status, created_by_id, reviewable_by_moderator, category_id, topic_id, score, potential_spam, target_id, target_type, target_created_by_id, payload, version, latest_score, force_review, potentially_illegal, created_at, updated_at) SELECT 9400 + i, 'ReviewableFlaggedPost', 'core', 1, 3, TRUE, 4, 35, i * 1.5, FALSE, 9400 + i, 'Post', 2, '{}', 1, now(), FALSE, FALSE, now(), now() FROM generate_series(1, 16) AS i

INSERT INTO reviewable_scores (reviewable_id, user_id, reviewable_score_type, status, score, take_action_bonus, user_accuracy_bonus, created_at, updated_at) SELECT 9400 + i, u, 3, 1, 1, 0, 0, now(), now() FROM generate_series(1, 16) AS i, (VALUES (3), (4)) AS v(u) WHERE i % 3 <> 0 OR u = 3
